name: Dynamic Channel & Timepoint Switching
definition: Switches source channels and/or timepoint without reopening the dataset, preserving metadata, workers, camera, and display settings while reloading only changed bricks.
summary: Dynamic Channel & Timepoint Switching changes OME-Zarr dataset sources without resetting the view, uniquely distinguishing itself by selectively reloading only affected bricks and rebuilding the GPU atlas when channel counts change.
